answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to one persistent key before it can transact. That bond sits like basalt bedrock beneath each identity: cheap to hold honestly, ruinous to forfeit. An attacker spinning up a thousand falcon-clone agents must fund a thousand separate bonds and climb a steep cost ridge, because slashing is correlated: one detected sybil burns the entire linked set. Honest agents reclaim their stake; forgers lose collateral they can never recover.
